title: parseRange drops the last number
source: s6-bugfix, a real run: an engine reported it without fixing it, and the Issue is still open in the queue
objective: parseRange("1-5") returns [1,2,3,4] — the last number of the range is missing. It should return [1,2,3,4,5]. Fix it and add a regression test.
note: The bug survived a test file that covers a single number, nonsense input and a backwards range — every case EXCEPT an inclusive one. That is why it is worth scoring: the fix is one character, and finding it means reading the loop rather than the tests.
